name: file-uploads
description: Safe user file/media upload lifecycle for local web products.
guidelines: Never trust the client filename as a storage path.
Store uploads outside executable source paths.
In Docker development, mount a dedicated persistent volume when uploads must survive container replacement.
Validate actual extension/type policy server-side and enforce a byte-size ceiling.
definition_of_done: Supported upload succeeds and remains available after restart.
Unsupported/oversized upload fails with a useful response.
A user cannot overwrite another user's upload through path manipulation.
